inlines.v: GUILE, noun gile. Craft; cunning; artifice; duplicity; deceit; usually in a bad sense. We may, with more successful hope, resolve To wage by force or guile eternal war. Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile John 1:47. GUILE, verb transitive To disguise craftily.
